newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tenaga to raise US$1 bln in Q1 - report.
newsitem.headline: Tenaga to raise US$1 bln in Q1 - report.

text.p: Malaysian utility firm Tenaga Nasional Bhd plans to raise US$1 billion from local and foreign markets during the first quarter of the year, Business Times said on Monday.
It quoted Tenaga's executive chairman Ahmad Tajuddin Ali as saying he was confident the company would not face any difficulty in raising the money, which will be used for its capital expenditure.
"The finance side indicated that there will be no problem in raising this amount and we are looking at correct timing.

"We have an endless stream of investment bankers coming in. We want to get the best deal for Tenaga," Tajuddin was quoted as saying. He said the company has yet to decide if the issue would be in the form of Eurobonds or U.S. dollar bonds.
Tenaga currently has about 47 percent of its loans in ringgit, 40 percent in U.S. dollars, nine percent in yen and two percent in sterling, the newspaper said.
